value.rationale: The four-cube is the canonical C4×C4 toroidal grid, a natural nonchordal cyclic benchmark for higher independence beyond the 2026 tree-only structural literature. Exact mixed-dimensional integral homotopy (16 classes degree three and one in degree four), including vanishing attaching map, is stronger than raw homology counts and discriminates prospective graph-class topology extensions. Finite scope is explicit, not arbitrary unmotivated slicing.
